title: Fibre Activation through Retail Agent
subtitle: FIB-ACT-RTL-001: Fibre and Fixed Wireless Access activation, assisted retail/field agent channel
footer: VFQ Fibre and Fixed Wireless Access Activation BRSD v1.0 | Wipro Limited for Vodafone Qatar

flow.title: Initiate Customer Interaction
desc: Journey initiation, agent authorisation, queue ticket and tracking record creation (capability JSM, reused from Mobile Post Paid Journey MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001)

flow.title: Initiate Customer Verification
desc: Identity document scan and MOI validation (capability KYC, reused from Mobile Post Paid Journey MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001)

flow.title: Initiate Customer Account Creation
desc: Customer/contact matching, new customer creation, account attributes (capability CAM, reused from Mobile Post Paid Journey MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001)

flow.title: Capture Installation Address
desc: Address by utility identifier or cascading zone/street/building/floor/flat search (BR-020, BR-021)

flow.title: Service Availability Search
desc: Search point of presence by address, utility identifier or area; auto fill address; detect CPE/ONT (BR-023, BR-024, BR-025)

flow.title: Lock Address and Upload Proof
desc: Installation address becomes read only after RFS check; recapture required to change it (BR-026); tenancy document uploaded, PDF/DOC, max 2MB (BR-022)

flow.title: Eligibility and Credit Control
desc: Connection type eligibility restricted to Qatar ID holder on postpaid; existing customer check via EDW, new customer check via QCA (BR-030, BR-031)

flow.title: Milestone: Contact Created, Eligibility Captured
desc: First milestone – customer contact created and product offer eligibility captured

flow.title: Capture Customer Bill Profile
desc: Billing account creation/selection, billing contact model, payment profile, bill cycle (capability BAM, reused from Mobile Post Paid Journey, postpaid only)

flow.title: Milestone: Bill Profile Created
desc: Second milestone – customer bill profile created (postpaid only)

flow.title: Product Selection
desc: Eligible fibre base plan display by service type and segment (BR-050); IPTV bundled by default, removable (BR-051); mapped add ons and discounts only (BR-052, BR-053); cart recalculates on every change (BR-054)

flow.title: Number and SIM/CPE Selection
desc: Fixed line number selection for fibre (BR-060); mobile number/star number rules for FWA (BR-061); SIM and CPE scan for FWA only (BR-062); number category and charges reviewed before confirmation (BR-063)

flow.title: Appointment Booking
desc: Fetch available slots with lead time and technician availability (BR-070); capture notes and CAF/tenancy collection flags (BR-071); skipped for FWA indoor, mandatory for FWA outdoor and fibre (BR-072)

flow.title: Workforce Task Execution
desc: Technician captures ONT, STB, mesh device quantity and wire length from the task (BR-073); first two mesh devices complimentary (BR-074)

flow.title: Workforce Task Closure
desc: Task closure with captured customer feedback required before the order proceeds

flow.title: Milestone: Cart Checked Out
desc: Third milestone – cart validated and checked out (capability CVC, reused from Mobile Post Paid Journey)

flow.title: Contract and Documentation
desc: Offline signed CAF upload, PDF/JPEG max 2MB (BR-082); digital signature via online form or touch screen (BR-083); submission skippable by fulfilment role (BR-084); supporting documents uploaded to a separate section

flow.title: Milestone: Signed CAF
desc: Fourth milestone – signed contract application form captured

flow.title: Payment and Inventory Depletion
desc: Payment collection (capability PAY, reused); fixed line number inventory depleted in UIM via fulfilment (BR-092); SIM/equipment inventory depleted for FWA on payment completion

flow.title: Order Submission
desc: Order submitted once all sections are filled/saved and payment has completed (BR-093)

flow.title: Milestone: Order Submitted
desc: Final order capture milestone – order submitted

flow.title: Network Activation and Fulfilment
desc: Network activation triggered on WFM task completion for fibre, status updated to CRM (BR-100); FWA indoor activates on planned date without a WFM task (BR-101); SIM activated with network for FWA (BR-102)

flow.title: Billing Update and Order Completion
desc: Account/product/service/resource information with per line prices passed to billing after task closure, including additional devices (BR-110); FWA indoor device billed at order capture (BR-111); order completion sets status to completed in CRM (BR-112); tracking record set to resolved with order number recorded (BR-113)

flow.title: Instant Activation Eligibility Detection
desc: A reusable pre-installed device eligible for instant activation is detected from the ready for service response (FAR_002_INS_01, BR-130).

flow.title: Channel Constraint Check
desc: Instant activation available only to field agents on a tablet device; physical device verification not supported on a desktop-only agent (BR-136, FAR_002_INS_07).

flow.title: Device Serial Verification
desc: Agent verifies the detected device serial number against the physical device before instant activation proceeds; a mismatch is recorded and may lead to failure (FAR_002_INS_02, BR-131).

no.label: Normal activation continues via the standard appointment/WFM path (FAR_002_INS_03, BR-132)

flow.title: Appointment Auto-Skip
desc: Appointment booking auto-skipped for instant activation; agent retains flexibility to book on customer request (FAR_002_INS_04, BR-133).

flow.title: Immediate Activation Trigger
desc: Immediate network activation flow triggered on order submission; completion target 30 minutes (FAR_002_INS_05, BR-134, P-21). Outcome is notified.

no.label: Instant Activation Failure Handling — a non-working service raises a support request and arranges a technician visit (FAR_002_INS_06, BR-135)

flow.title: Migration Eligibility Validation
desc: Migration is permitted only from active FWA Indoor or FWA Outdoor services to Fibre (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_01, BR-140A).

flow.title: Customer Verification
desc: Customer verification must be completed before migration order creation (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_02, BR-141).

flow.title: Fibre Availability Validation
desc: Migration can proceed only where Fibre service is RFS-ready at the installation address (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_03, BR-140B).

flow.title: Existing Service Retrieval
desc: Existing FWA service details retrieved for the migration (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_04).

flow.title: Migration Order Capture
desc: Lead ID, opportunity ID, language, alternate contact and enterprise-care flag are mandatory migration attributes (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_05, BR-142).

flow.title: Fibre Installation Appointment
desc: Mandatory for all migrations. Telephone-originated requests require CAF and tenancy collection flags (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_06, BR-143, FIB_MIG_RTL_003_07). FWA Outdoor migrations require a separate outdoor device recovery appointment (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_08, BR-144).

flow.title: Existing Service Continuity
desc: Existing FWA service remains active until Fibre activation succeeds (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_09, BR-145A). Fibre activation cannot occur before successful installation closure (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_10, BR-145B).

meta.businessMeaning: Failed Fibre migration shall not automatically terminate the existing FWA service (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_15, BR-145F).

flow.title: SIM Deactivation & Resource Release
desc: FWA SIM deactivation occurs only after successful Fibre activation; connection and services terminated (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_11, BR-145). FWA resources released only after successful migration completion (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_12, BR-145C).

flow.title: Billing Migration Cutover & Notification
desc: Billing for Fibre begins on migration completion date; FWA billing ceases on the same date (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_13, BR-145D). Customers notified at request creation, appointment confirmation, migration completion and migration failure (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_14, BR-145E).

flow.title: New Installation Address Capture
desc: Created through the store queue or by a support agent, routed to the fibre fulfilment team queue (FIB_HMV_RTL_004_01, BR-150). New installation address captured and its service availability checked for the new location (FIB_HMV_RTL_004_02, BR-151, P-18).

flow.title: Fixed Line Number Retention & Appointment
desc: A new fixed line number is refused for a Home Move order — the existing number is retained (FIB_HMV_RTL_004_03, BR-152). New location installation appointment booked (FIB_HMV_RTL_004_03).

flow.title: Old Location Device Retention / Uninstallation
desc: No uninstallation appointment is captured for a fibre-to-fibre home move; the device is retained at the old location (FIB_HMV_RTL_004_04, BR-153). Uninstallation appointment for the FWA Outdoor device at the old location for a move originating from FWA Outdoor (FIB_HMV_RTL_004_05, BR-154).

flow.title: Service Termination & Inventory Release at Old Location
desc: All services at the old location terminated on the confirmed move date (FIB_HMV_RTL_004_06, BR-155). Customer premises equipment and IP address at the old location released on the confirmed move date (FIB_HMV_RTL_004_07, BR-156).

flow.title: WFM Task Execution at New Location
desc: Field workforce task executed to install service at the new location (FIB_HMV_RTL_004_08).

flow.title: Move Date Billing Update
desc: Billing triggered on the move date for new location activation and updated for old location termination (FIB_HMV_RTL_004_09, BR-157). FWA equipment carried by the customer to the new location and handed over at the store where the move is to a FWA area (FIB_HMV_RTL_004_10, BR-158).

flow.title: Ported Number Capture
desc: Fixed line number being ported in is captured; new number selection is refused for a port in (FIB_FPI_RTL_005_01, BR-160).

flow.title: Portability Identifier & Appointment Date
desc: Portability identifier marked during appointment booking (FIB_FPI_RTL_005_02, BR-161). Appointment date auto-set to Installation Date + 5 business days, excluding Friday and Saturday (FIB_FPI_RTL_005_03, BR-161A).

flow.title: Portability Form Submission
desc: Portability form completed, signed by the customer and uploaded before the port in proceeds (FIB_FPI_RTL_005_04, BR-162).

flow.title: Portability Request Creation
desc: Portability request created and submitted to the number portability administration system (FIB_FPI_RTL_005_05, BR-163, INT-15).

flow.title: Request Confirmation by Donor Provider
desc: Portability request validated and confirmed in the portability administration system by the donor service provider (FIB_FPI_RTL_005_06, BR-164).

flow.title: Appointment Date Reconfirmation
desc: Portability appointment date must be rescheduled based on the confirmed port-in date (BR-164A).

flow.title: Portability WFM Appointment Execution
desc: Field workforce management appointment executed for the portability task (FIB_FPI_RTL_005_07).

flow.title: Ported Number Activation
desc: Ported number activated after portability completion and configured during the task; no temporary number is provided (FIB_FPI_RTL_005_08, BR-165).

flow.label: Start — Port Out Request from NPAS

flow.title: Trouble Ticket & Queue Assignment
desc: A port out request from the number portability administration system creates a trouble ticket in Siebel CRM (FIB_FPO_RTL_006_01, BR-170). Ticket auto-assigned to the portability queue; initial validation service level timer started, 2 hours (FIB_FPO_RTL_006_02, BR-171, P-11).

flow.title: Document & Mandatory Field Validation
desc: Portability form and identity document validated; documents may be uploaded to the ticket (FIB_FPO_RTL_006_03, BR-172). Form date within the allowed period, 30 days; customer name, identity document number and service type match system records (FIB_FPO_RTL_006_04, BR-173, P-10).

flow.title: Service Level Extension
desc: A pending bill moves the request to conditionally accepted with a defined settlement window, 24 hours (FIB_FPO_RTL_006_05, BR-174, P-13). A valid document set extends the service level timer to the final action period, 24 hours (FIB_FPO_RTL_006_06, BR-175, P-12).

flow.title: Auto-Processing on Breach
desc: A request with no action within the service level is auto-processed per the configured rule, auto-accept vs auto-reject to be confirmed (FIB_FPO_RTL_006_07, BR-176).

flow.title: Status Communication to NPAS
desc: Every accept, reject and conditional acceptance action communicated to NPAS with the defined status code, rejection code list to be supplied by VFQ (FIB_FPO_RTL_006_08, BR-177, P-14, P-20).

flow.title: Termination Order & Network Deactivation
desc: Termination order generated from the closed ticket with a non-editable wish date equal to the confirmed portability date (FIB_FPO_RTL_006_09, BR-178). Services deactivated on the confirmed portability date with a one-hour activation window towards the new provider (FIB_FPO_RTL_006_10, BR-179, P-15).

flow.title: Inventory Quarantine
desc: Ported inventory quarantined for the configured period, 90 days; SIM deactivated and released for FWA (FIB_FPO_RTL_006_11, BR-180, P-16).

flow.title: Customer & Service Eligibility Validation
desc: Initiated from Customer 360 or a linked disconnection ticket by an authorised Retail or Retention user (FIB_TER_RTL_007_01, BR-200). Termination may proceed only for an active eligible Fibre/FWA service with no conflicting open order or restricted block (FIB_TER_RTL_007_02, BR-201).

meta.businessMeaning: A retention outcome is mandatory before termination order creation where the process is routed through Retention (FIB_TER_RTL_007_03, BR-202).

flow.title: Outstanding Dues Validation
desc: Outstanding dues handling must follow the configured VFQ settlement rule before termination completion (FIB_TER_RTL_007_04, BR-203).

flow.title: Penalty Charge Display
desc: Early termination or lock-in penalty calculated and shown where the service is within the applicable minimum subscription period; plan lock-in is 3 months per the CAF (FIB_TER_RTL_007_05, BR-204).

flow.title: Consent & Reason Capture
desc: Customer consent, termination reason and requested termination date are mandatory before submission (BR-205).

flow.title: Equipment Recovery Appointment
desc: WFM recovery appointment mandatory for configured service/device scenarios, skipped where recovery is not required (FIB_TER_RTL_007_06, BR-206).

flow.title: Termination Order Capture & Submission
desc: Termination order created only after validations, consent and recovery rules are satisfied (FIB_TER_RTL_007_07, BR-207). Termination order submitted to Order Management (FIB_TER_RTL_007_08).

flow.title: Network Deactivation & Billing Closure
desc: Occurs on the confirmed termination date; outcome returned to CRM (FIB_TER_RTL_007_09, BR-208). Final billing posted after termination, including outstanding, penalty, credit/refund and closure details where applicable (FIB_TER_RTL_007_10, BR-209).

flow.title: Resource Release / Quarantine & Notification
desc: Service resources released, recovered or quarantined according to resource type and configured rules (FIB_TER_RTL_007_11, BR-210, FIB_TER_RTL_007_13). Customer notifications triggered at configured termination milestones (FIB_TER_RTL_007_12, BR-211).

flow.title: Site & Building Data Ingestion
desc: Site and building data from the geographic information system ingested into the inventory management system, the master for building and connectivity data (FIB_RFS_008_01, BR-190).

flow.title: Go-To-Market File Generation
desc: The go-to-market file is generated from the inventory management system as a full extract (BR-191).

flow.title: Pickup, Transformation & Distribution
desc: Go-to-market file picked up through the mediation layer and transformed into the format required by each downstream system (FIB_RFS_008_01, BR-192). Distributed to the inventory management system, ready for service portal, Siebel CRM and the analytics data warehouse — IMS receives a full extract, CRM a delta (FIB_RFS_008_02, BR-193, INT-16).

flow.title: Vodafone Identifier Generation & Mapping
desc: Operator identifier generated separately and mapped to the utility identifier through field survey, supporting one-to-one and one-to-many relationships (FIB_RFS_008_03, BR-194).

flow.title: Ready for Service Status Update
desc: A building is marked ready for service once ready for provisioning, with its service level category recorded (FIB_RFS_008_04, BR-195). Feeds the RFS search used by activation and the RFS availability check used by migration.

flow.title: RFS Portal Search & Recommendation
desc: Ready for service portal searchable by address, utility identifier or area (FIB_RFS_008_05, BR-196). Offer recommendations from the big data system received into the ready for service portal (FIB_RFS_008_06, BR-197).

flow.title: Lead Creation from Portal
desc: A lead is created in Siebel CRM from the portal using the mobile number (FIB_RFS_008_07, BR-198).

flow.title: Continuous RFS Update
desc: Ready for service data updated by subsequent go-to-market file loads and by manual business updates (FIB_RFS_008_08, BR-199, P-19).

loops.label: failed migration – FWA service remains active, retry
